phase_1_bench_validation.objective: V0 bench prototype: 4-segment shunt + COTS sensors + Arduino. 30 obstruction scenarios. Measure multi vs single peak ICP.
phase_1_bench_validation.pass_criteria: Multi-segment peak ICP < single-segment in >=80% of scenarios

phase_2_prototype.objective: Build functional prototype incorporating bench-validated mechanism

phase_3_relevant_environment.objective: Test in clinically relevant environment (cadaver, animal, or simulated)
